name: SSH MCP Server
description: A Model Context Protocol server that allows LLMs to securely execute shell commands on remote Linux and Windows systems via SSH. It supports password and key-based authentication, command timeouts, and sudo elevation for administrative tasks.

rawRecord.description: A Model Context Protocol server that allows LLMs to securely execute shell commands on remote Linux and Windows systems via SSH. It supports password and key-based authentication, command timeouts, and sudo elevation for administrative tasks.

host.description: Hostname or IP of the Linux or Windows server

timeout.description: Command execution timeout in milliseconds (default: 60000ms = 1 minute)

maxChars.description: Maximum allowed characters for the command input (default: 1000). Use none or 0 to disable the limit.

password.description: SSH password (or use key for key-based auth)

suPassword.description: Password for su elevation (when you need a persistent root shell)

disableSudo.description: Flag to disable the sudo-exec tool completely. Useful when sudo access is not needed or not available.

sudoPassword.description: Password for sudo elevation (when executing commands with sudo)
